layers.description: Shows projected human footprint intensity to provide pressure context across the landscape.
Shows marine human modification intensity used as the fixed cost surface for supported marine conservation solutions.
Shows potential agricultural net benefit; higher values indicate higher opportunity cost for conservation.
Protected areas from RUNAP (2023) that are treated as already conserved in planning outputs.
Combined SIRAP boundary review layer containing territorial SIRAPs and thematic SIRAP additions.
layers.tooltip: SIRAP stands for Sistema Regional de Áreas Protegidas, Colombia's regional protected area system. This is the SIRAP boundaries layer, so the Spanish source term "límites" refers to the boundary lines shown on the map. The combined layer includes territorial SIRAP boundaries plus thematic additions such as Eje Cafetero and Macizo.

layers.description: Broad territorial SIRAP / DT boundary polygons.
layers.tooltip: Territorial SIRAPs are the broad regional conservation systems used as overarching SIRAP categories.

layers.description: Thematic SIRAP additions isolated for Eje Cafetero and Macizo.
layers.tooltip: Thematic SIRAPs are special additions, such as Eje Cafetero and Macizo, that may overlap territorial SIRAPs.
